subject: Dedicated capacity top-up + co-term PO amendment for renewal (Aurora Medical)
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@auroramed.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Lee <j.lee@auroramed.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity increase request + co-term with upcoming renewal

Ben —

Thanks again for the renewal call last week. Quick recap from our side: our imaging ingestion pipeline is growing faster than we modeled and the team is asking to top up reserved capacity when we process the renewal next month rather than doing a separate purchase later. High level ask: +8 A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved pool instance) for 12 months, co-termed with our existing Dedicated contract (renewal date 2026-06-15).

Key requirements:
- Dedicated reserved pool, isolated to Aurora account (no shared tenancy)
- Throughput target: sustained 45k tokens/minute across the pool with 95th percentile latency <= 220ms for 2k-sequence requests
- Option to burst additional capacity (on-demand) up to +30% for scheduled campaigns

Procurement prefers a single PO amendment that co-terms with the renewal and updates the billing schedule (monthly invoices consolidated under the renewed contract). Can you confirm if Redwood can:
1) Amend the existing PO with a single line item for the additional GPUs and updated monthly charge,
2) Keep the new capacity on the same contract term (co-term), and
3) Provide a short SLA/throughput appendix we can attach to the PO?

I've attached a draft internal PO and our procurement contact is cc'd (James). Looking for an estimate and next steps so we can loop in finance.

Thanks —
Alicia
Director of AI Engineering
Aurora Medical Systems
Attachment: aurora_po_draft_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@auroramed.ai>
Cc: James Lee <j.lee@auroramed.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity increase request + co-term with upcoming renewal

Alicia —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Short answer: yes, we can co-term the capacity increase with your upcoming renewal and issue a single PO amendment that updates the monthly billing schedule. I put together an initial approach below and looped in our Solutions and Finance leads to finalize language and pricing.

Proposal (high level):
- Add: 8x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs (Dedicated pool)
- Term: co-term to existing contract (new end date remains 2027-06-15)
- Billing: monthly invoiced amount pro-rated from effective date; then full monthly invoice aligned with existing renewal cycle
- Throughput appendix: we will provide a short SLA with throughput guarantees and a burst policy (burst metered on usage at a lower priority; guaranteed capacity limited to reserved pool)

Next steps:
1) Internal alignment on pricing and SLA text (cc: @priyom_das and @marissa_cole)
2) Redwood sends PO amendment draft + SLA appendix for Aurora legal/procurement review
3) Aurora to sign amendment or send redlines; Redwood to return final DocuSign link

I'll start pricing scenarios and share a PO amendment draft by EOD tomorrow. If you need a tighter latency guarantee we can look at a different instance mix (smaller count with higher per-GPU throughput) — let me know.

Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Aurora capacity top-up / co-term pricing and billing language

Team —

Aurora (AUR-2026-387) wants to add +8 A100-equivalent reserved GPUs co-termed to their renewal on 2026-06-15. They need a single PO amendment, monthly invoices aligned to their renewal billing cadence, and a short throughput SLA appendix.

Questions for pricing/legal/finance:
- Pricing: propose $X per GPU/month (TBD). Can we offer a 7% volume discount if they commit to a 12-month co-term for the new capacity?
- Billing: finance will we pro-rate the first partial month and then move to their renewal invoice cycle? Also need language for consolidated invoicing and purchase order numbers.
- SLA: priyom — can you draft a 1-page throughput appendix with measurable metrics (95th pct latency, sustained tokens/min target, burst policy) we can attach to the PO?

I attached the customer's PO draft. I'll own the external comms, priyom please draft appendix, Marissa please coordinate CS handoff and capacity onboarding timeline, Stephanie please prepare PO amendment template and invoice wording.

Attachment: aurora_po_draft_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Ben
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Aurora capacity top-up / co-term pricing and billing language

Ben / Marissa —

Drafted a 1-page throughput appendix (see summary below). I'll attach a formal doc for the PO amendment. Main points:

Throughput appendix (summary):
- Reserved pool: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs dedicated to Aurora account
- Throughput target: sustained 45,000 tokens/min across the pool (measured as 5-minute rolling average)
- Latency target: 95th percentile <= 220ms for requests up to 2,048 tokens
- Burst policy: allow up to +30% additional tokens/minute for scheduled windows; burst usage billed as metered on-demand at published burst rates
- Availability: reserved pool SLA (monthly uptime >= 99.5%); credits applied per standard SLA terms for violations
- Onboarding: 5 business days for capacity provisioning after amendment execution; capacity sizing validation during first 14 days

Pricing ask: I'll run perf numbers on our fleet to refine GPU-equivalent pricing. Initial estimate: $2,800/GPU/month list; propose 7% discount for the 12-month co-term top-up.

I'll upload a formal appendix and a throughput CSV that shows expected token throughput by instance type.

—Priyom

Attachment: throughput_sla_summary.csv (csv)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Aurora capacity top-up / co-term pricing and billing language

Ben/Team —

Finance can support the single PO amendment and co-term billing. Notes below for the amendment template and invoice schedule:

Billing template language (suggested):
- Effective Date: date of amendment signature; charges for added reserved capacity will be pro-rated from Effective Date through the next invoice cycle.
- Consolidated invoicing: additional reserved capacity charges will appear as a separate line on the monthly invoice tied to the original contract number (Contract: RWI-2024-098).
- PO number: Aurora must reference the amendment PO number on future invoices; Redwood will include the amendment PO number and original contract number on all invoices.
- Payment terms: Net 30 (unless Aurora requires different terms; procurement will confirm).

DocuSign flow: Finance will accept amendment signature via DocuSign. Please confirm final amounts and attach the appendix and customer PO.

I've prepared a PO amendment template (redwood_amendment_terms.docx). Will populate pricing and the pro-rate calculation once Ben confirms numbers.

Stephanie Nguyen
Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@auroramed.ai>, James Lee <j.lee@auroramed.ai>, Aurora Med Finance <finance@auroramed.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora — PO amendment and DocuSign for co-term dedicated pool top-up

Alicia / James —

Thanks for confirming the ask. Attached are the PO amendment draft and the 1-page throughput appendix for your review: aurora_po_draft_v2.pdf and redwood_amendment_terms.docx. Summary of agreed items:

- Add 8x A100-equivalent GPUs to Aurora's Dedicated reserved pool, co-termed to 2027-06-15.
- Pricing: $2,604/GPU/month after 7% co-term top-up discount (monthly charge = $20,832).
- Billing: pro-rated charges from effective date; then consolidated monthly invoice under contract RWI-2024-098; Net 30 payment terms.
- SLA Appendix: sustained 45k tokens/min (5-min rolling avg), 95th pct latency <= 220ms up to 2,048 tokens, reserved pool uptime >= 99.5%, burst +30% billed metered on-demand.
- Onboarding window: provisioning begins within 5 business days of amendment signature; 14-day validation window.

Action items:
1) Aurora: review attached amendment and appendix; send redlines by EOD Tue 2026-06-01 if any.
2) Redwood: we'll populate final DocuSign envelope once pricing and any redlines are agreed.
3) Finance: Stephanie to generate amendment invoice schedule after signature.

DocuSign link (will be created after redline loop): https://docusign.com/aurora/redwood-amendment-23x

Attachment: aurora_po_draft_v2.pdf (pdf); redwood_amendment_terms.docx (docx)
